RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the November 25, 2005/Agrahayana 4, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Environmental clearance to Balachaur-
Hoshiarpur-Dasuya highway
*41. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA : Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a proposal sent by the
Punjab Government for removing/cutting
of trees for upgradation of the Balachaur-
Hoshiarpur-Dasuya highway is pending for
environmental clearance;
(b) if so, since when the request is
pending; and
(c) by when, the clearance is likely to
be accorded?
Commissions/Committees on rail
accidents
*42. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:  Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state :
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to set up a special commission/
committee to find out the reasons/causes
of rail accidents;
(b) if so, the total number of such
Commissions/Committees set up by
Government during the last three months,
month-wise; and
(c) when the reports of the
Commissions/Committees are expected to
be received by Government?
Relaxation of  Coastal Zonal
Regulation
*43. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN :
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state :
(a) whether the State Government of
Maharashtra has sought the relaxation of
Coastal Zonal Regulation, 1991 for some
areas in Mumbai;
(b) if so, the names of such areas;
(c) the reaction of the Central
Government thereto; and
(d) the reasons for not accepting the
proposal?
Encouraging investment in agricultural
marketing infrastructure projects
*44. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided

14
to come out with an innovative scheme to
encourage entrepreneurs investing in
agricultural marketing infrastructure
projects;
(b) if so, whether this move is aimed at
bringing down risk threat for both
entrepreneurs and banks;
(c) whether venture capital scheme was
part of Government's effort to bridge the
gap between producer and consumer;
(d) whether the scheme covers a wide
range of agricultural and allied sectors'
activities including collection, cleaning,
grading, quality certification, labelling,
packing, ripening chambers, retailing,
wholesale and value addition facilities; and
(e) if so, by when these schemes are
likely to be implemented?
Revival of IISCO
*45.  SHRI  KALRAJ  MISHRA:  Will
the Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Iron and Steel
Company continues to be a loss-making
concern, if so, the production, profit and
loss incurred by each of its units since 2001
onwards;
(b) whether some of its units have been
lying idle fully or partially, if so, the details
thereof; and
(c) the steps taken and proposed to be
taken to revive the same and the strategy
contemplated to revive and rejuvenate this
PSU?
National Accreditation Board
*46. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to  state :
(a) whether Government have
announced formation of a task force
comprising experts from the Ministries of
Health and Family Welfare, Tourism,
Railways, External Affairs, Civil Aviation
and Director General of Health Services to
suggest strengthening the policy measures
and norms for National Accreditation
Board to provide accreditation to private
hospitals;
(b) whether Government will also come
out with Clinical Establishment Act;
(c) whether Government have also
announced that policy decision for granting
of medical visa will also be considered; and
(d) whether the Ministry of Tourism
will also aid the Ministry in giving strategic
push to Indian health-care sector in foreign
markets?
Passenger-upgrade scheme
*47. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA : Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
 state :
(a) whether the free passenger-upgrade
scheme announced recently by Railways
is operational;
(b) if so, the total amount saved, so far,
by Railways on account of not having to
refund money for waitlisted tickets;
(c) if not, by when the scheme would
be made operational; and
(d) the launch status of other passenger-
friendly services by Railways, like bundling
of hotel services alongwith train ticket
bookings?
Dioxins in eggs
*48.  SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI:
 DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that an NGO

15
called "Toxic Link" has reported that eggs
produced in the country contain high level
of dioxins which is a poisonous chemical;
(b) if so, the facts of the matter; and
(c) the corrective measures taken by the
Government in this regard?
Shortage of onion

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 Onion shortage
285. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
had been experiencing shortage of onions
for the last ten months;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that the pro-
duction of onions had suffered; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Flood/drought assistance to States
†286. DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the States hit by floods
or flood like situation or were affected by
drought during this year;
(b) the loss of life and property in the
States affected by droughts or floods;
(c) the amount of financial help
demanded by the affected States from the
Central Government and the actual amount
given to these States, State-wise; and
(d) the reasons for not giving the help
according to the demand and whether the
remaining amount of help is likely to be
given in future, if so, the details thereof?
Prices of onions
287. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that while the
prices of onion skyrocketed throughout
India from September 2005, cheap onions
rotted in godowns in Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any action has been taken
against the hoarders who created shortage
in supply of onions; and
(d) the reasons for which Government
had not taken steps to procure and supply
cheap Rajasthan onions throughout the
country to bring down prices of onions?

66
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Farmers living below poverty line
288. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of farmers in the
country, and percentage of total population
of the country;
(b) how many of the above farmers are
living below poverty line, the percentage
thereof, and how does it compare with total
percentage of people living below poverty
line for the whole country;
(c) the per capita income of the above
farmers who are living beyond poverty line,
and how it compares with average per
capita income of the country; and
(d) the special steps being taken by
Government to ameliorate the pitiable plight
of these poorest of the poor farmers?
Supplying Urea and DAP to States
289. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Urea and Di-Ammonium
Phosphate (DAP) fertilizers are in great
demand in some States;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether these fertilizers are supplied
to States for the use of farmers as per their
requirement?
Failure of Bt. Cotton
†290. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether crop of the Bt. Cotton
failed in many parts of the country and the
farmers had to incur heavy losses;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to compensate these losses;
(c) whether the Bt. Cotton variety is
unnecessary for India; and
(d) if so, the details of the meaningful
steps taken to curb the same?
Banning Chemical Fertilizers
291. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have identified thirty-seven chemical
fertilizers such as monochrotophas to ban;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether consultations have been held
before banning them with the stake-holders;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Identification of new varieties of
wheat by ICAR
292. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the ICAR
has identified seven new varieties of wheat
for release;
(b) if so, the details thereof and how
these are suitable to different agro-climatic
conditions in the country; and
(c) the advantage identified and the
additional yield that the farmers are going
to get from these new varieties?

67
Farmers leaving Agriculture
†293. SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the number of farmers leaving
the profession of agriculture is
continuously on the increase;
(b) if so, the details of the such cases,
State-wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
condition of farmers is miserable which is
driving them to commit suicides; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?

Schemes
